description: This file implements functions related to capturing and unwinding stack traces in the Abseil library, including platform-specific stack unwinding mechanisms and a customizable unwinder interface.

methods.name: Unwind
methods.description: Template function that performs stack unwinding using a selected unwinder, supporting different platform-specific implementations and contexts.

methods.name: GetStackFrames
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack frames without context, up to a maximum depth.

methods.name: GetStackFramesWithContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack frames with context information, up to a maximum depth.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack trace without context, up to a maximum depth.

methods.name: GetStackTraceWithContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack trace with context, up to a maximum depth.

methods.name: SetStackUnwinder
methods.description: Sets a custom stack unwinder function.

methods.name: DefaultStackUnwinder
methods.description: Default implementation of the stack unwinder that chooses the appropriate unwinding method based on environment.
